lines.text: There's too much lag, I can't play.

data.define: A delay between what you do and what happens on screen.

example.text: There's too much lag, I can't play.

misuse.text: Don't say 'lag' about a person's slow walking.
misuse.why: It describes slow connections, not people.

publish.title: What does "lag" mean?
publish.value: Lag = Slow and delayed connection. Example: "There's too much lag, I can't play." (casual English).
